note: Authoritative stage-to-capability routing for the four public commands (/grill /plan /build /fix, plus /resume). Every skill body, command wrapper and reference defers to this table; summaries may cite it but must not weaken it. domain_skills are selected per acceptance boundary via the Skill Applicability Selection procedure in subagent-orchestration.md - they are additional, conditionally required capabilities, never a blanket call-everything rule.

stages.entry: final brief handoff at the end of /grill

reviewer.scope: the finalizing brief version only; individual interview rounds are not reviewed

stages.domain_skills: select when the brief's acceptance items involve a technology or real boundary with a matching available skill

reviewer.scope: goal card semantics, coverage and verification design; never demands contract/PLAN/manifest artifacts

stages.domain_skills: none expected; select only if the goal's verification itself depends on a specialized capability

stages.entry: Normal/Guarded implementation work packages in /build or /fix
stages.domain_skills: select per work package when the touched technology has a matching available skill; the worker seat loads it without gaining permissions beyond its agent definition

stages.entry: material Normal/Guarded slice acceptance handoff (each slice, affected-scope changes)

reviewer.scope: current slice and affected scope; no reconcile/manifest/SI artifacts

stages.domain_skills: select when verifying the slice needs a specialized read-only capability; read-only reviewers request executions via CONTROLLER_ACTION
select per contract boundary (migration, privacy, GUI, ...)
rare; only when the PLAN's own verification depends on one
select when writing the frozen tests requires a specialized capability; test-author's edit boundary unchanged

stages.entry: Audited PLAN step execution and its verify-step gate

reviewer.dispatch: per Audited gate (step review / converge-audit as applicable)

stages.domain_skills: select per step technology; official V stays controller-owned
select per slice boundary; owner acceptance never delegated

stages.entry: whole-goal finish check before finish-goal (all rigor modes)

reviewer.scope: original request/every brief BS, whole goal, deferred work, real user-entry journeys; a clean slice audit never substitutes

stages.domain_skills: select for the final integrated verification boundary (GUI, browser, data, security, ...)

dispatch_levels.capability-available-mandatory: dispatch whenever the seat exists at runtime; cost is never an exemption. Fallback tiers per subagent-orchestration.md Failure Branches.
dispatch_levels.blocking: Audited independence gates block on unavailability; no controller downgrade.
dispatch_levels.none-for-this-stage: no reviewer dispatch is attached to this stage unit; reviews happen at the acceptance handoffs above

reuse_rules.same_version_single_seat: one reviewer return may cover multiple declared acceptance items for one stable artifact version and scope
reuse_rules.never_cross_scope_or_version: a slice review never substitutes whole-goal review; changed artifacts invalidate prior returns
reuse_rules.cards_are_not_dispatch_units: goal-verification/test-freeze/step-verification cards do not add reviewer dispatches by themselves

seat_requirements.reviewer-subagent: fresh dispatch, read-only, loads reviewer skill; loads pua when pua_stage_id supplied; pua_acceptance required with matching stage_id
seat_requirements.worker-subagent: loads task-worker skill; one writer at a time
seat_requirements.test-author-subagent: fresh dispatch, loads test-author skill, edit limited to tests/manifest
seat_requirements.step-executor-subagent: fresh dispatch per Audited seat-selection table; loads step-executor skill
